scope: Every actual finite field K, every natural r nonzero in K: derive primitive root, simple all-root adjoin in AlgebraicClosureK, finite dimension/carrier and actual Frobenius order, giving actual Module.finrank=orderOf(cardK:ZModr). Actual degree dividesn iff r dividescardK^n-1. For every actual finite intermediate field L, actual all-root containment/rationality iff r divides Nat.cardL-1, equivalently cardK^actualfinrankL-1, via splitting descent and actual finite-module cardinality. Every finite characteristicp field yields actual rootfieldp=bottom/degree1 versus modularorder0 and p does not dividecardK-1, refuting deletion of nonzero-characteristic guard. Every field actual r1/r2 root-adjoin degree1. Credited existing arguments generalized; correctly qualified source cyclotomic bridge survives. Not full elliptic torsion field/canonical Weil-Tate geometric comparison, nonprime SS classification, isogeny/Lang/Cartier/Jacobian/divisor/MOV-FR or all14 completion. No novelty claim/canonical promotion.
